summary: Iteration 26: New 5-step conversational bot flow testing - All 14 backend tests passed, all frontend tests passed. critical_code_review_comments: New 5-step bot flow implementation verified working:
1. SYSTEM_PROMPT (lines 20-125): Defines 5-step sequential flow with clear instructions
2. _build_conversation_context (lines 698-788): Builds context for AI including missing fields and next_to_ask
3. _is_quote_ready (lines 811-818): Simplified check for codes + qty + email + empresa
4. ESCALATION_KEYWORDS (lines 129-137): List of keywords that trigger human transfer
5. detect_escalation (lines 678-683): Pre-AI detection of escalation keywords
7. notify_staff_new_quote (lines 591-620): Sends WhatsApp notification to staff
9. ADDITIONAL_FIELDS (lines 689-695): Ordered list of step 5 fields to collect
NOTE: Model temporarily changed to gpt-4o for testing (gpt-5.2 has connection errors), then reverted back
